serviceName: Kastana booking page on a sub-address of your own domain
description: Points a sub-address of your own domain, such as book.yourshop.co.uk, at your Kastana booking page. Use it with the host set to the sub-address. Adds two records: one that proves the domain is yours, and one that sends visitors to your shop.
variableDescription: verify is the one-off value that proves the domain belongs to the shop (letters and numbers, made by Kastana for each domain).
